name: Brightwater Careers
description: A warm, culture-led careers page: a photo-collage hero, values and benefits as cards, words from the team with portraits, office cards, then roles as two-up cards with their facts as chips.
modelledOn: A collaboration app’s culture-led careers page
features: Composed front page: photo-collage hero, values cards, benefits grid, testimonials with portraits, studio cards, the roles board
Board preset: cards — two roles to a row, their facts as pill chips, a lift on hover
Filter by team and location from dropdowns
Role page: facts as chips, share links and “More roles” from the same team
Two pages beside the roles (life here, benefits) marked as pages, not openings
Warm palette with a serif display face
Zero custom CSS — every detail is a theme setting
Type: Newsreader and Inter (served from our own font store)
Office map: each studio’s address on a street map (served from our own origin — no third-party request)

frontDoor.eeoStatement: We want a team that reflects the people who use what we make. If something in this listing gives you pause, apply anyway — and tell us what we can do to make the process work for you.

content.text: Make tools that help people make things
We are a team of designers, engineers and storytellers building a calmer place to think and work together.

content.text: What we value

attrs.title: Craft over speed
attrs.description: We would rather make one thing beautifully than three things quickly.

attrs.title: Kindness is a skill
attrs.description: Direct, warm and generous with credit.

attrs.title: Stay curious
attrs.description: Every one of us is still learning how to do this well.

attrs.title: 25 days off
attrs.description: Plus a winter week off for everyone.

content.text: From the team

items.quote: I shipped something in my first week, and nobody needed to sign it off. That trust is the whole job.
items.author: Priya N.

items.quote: The winter week off is real. The whole company goes quiet and comes back with ideas.
items.author: Tomás R.

items.quote: Managers here coach. I have grown more in two years than in the five before.
items.author: Hannah L.
